|translation='''Title:''' Stagnant filthy water.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on any exterior location on a planet except Hoth. Or deploy on an interior vehicle location card. At that place, Force drains by the opponent are −1. If a swamp creature is at the same place, this Effect is not affected by Alter.

'''Lore:'''
A swamp-born predator lurks in damp, filthy places and creeps up without a sound. “Something just touched my leg!”

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is よどみきった汚水 (stagnant filthy water).
